provenance: Extracted via master-diff, not hand-authored: pixel-wise diff of master-03-raw.png (both peak LEDs lit) against master-05.png (same faceplate re-rendered with neither LED lit) after local sub-pixel registration to null out inter-render drift; connected-component filtered to the LED's core+halo blob; soft alpha taken from the registered diff magnitude so the halo survives as a gradient; RGB taken unshifted directly from master-03-raw.png. Centre is the diff-weighted centroid of the lit blob (radially symmetric core+halo). offsetFromDialCentreFracRadius lets this same sprite be placed on either dial: ledPos = dialCentre + offsetFrac * dialRadius -- BUT this is only approximate: the two dials are not perfectly congruent in this render (measured transfer error is +57.9,+15.2 px on the right dial), so prefer a direct per-dial diff measurement (rightDialLedCentreInMasterDirectlyMeasured, done the same way as the left LED) whenever both masters are available, and fall back to the offset fraction only when they are not.
